Manage limits

```sh
bronto limits <command> [flags]
```

#### Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`bronto limits create`](/reference/commands/limits/#bronto-limits-create) | Create a limit |
| [`bronto limits delete`](/reference/commands/limits/#bronto-limits-delete) | Delete a limit |
| [`bronto limits get`](/reference/commands/limits/#bronto-limits-get) | Get a limit by ID |
| [`bronto limits list`](/reference/commands/limits/#bronto-limits-list) | List limits |
| [`bronto limits update`](/reference/commands/limits/#bronto-limits-update) | Update a limit |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

## bronto limits create

Create a limit

```sh
bronto limits create [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--field` | `-f` | stringArray |  | key=value pair for the request body (repeatable) |
| `--input` |  | string |  | request body from file, or - for stdin |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto limits create -f name=x -f limit=10
bronto limits create --input body.json
```
